meta.name: Pewter Splash Dampener
meta.description: A wind-up clockwork charm from the Scriptorium of Hollow Quill, crafted by The Perpetual Clockwork Deep-Bore Syndicate. Forged from kettle-grade pewter gravel, this monastic relic absorbs kinetic excess when carried or placed in the house. It perfectly clamps secondary shockwaves so splash damage never cracks fragile tiles.
